feed.title: Evan's Writings
feed.subtitle: Agents, Data, DeFi, Math — collected writings by Evan Kim.

entry.title: Knowledge vs Execution in a Qwen3.5-2B Data Agent
entry.summary: One SFT pass with LoRA on verified SmolDataEnvs trajectories doesn't move Qwen accuracy. The information ladder shows why.

entry.title: The Information Ladder: Measuring Model Capabilities
entry.summary: We build LadderBench, 591 synthetic Go tasks from 9 repositories, and use the information ladder to certify 242 of them and compare Composer 2.5 and SWE-2. Each level reveals more to the solver, so the first level a model passes shows how much information is needed.

entry.title: Four Verifiable Properties of a Useful Agent Task
entry.summary: Soundness and difficulty settle by running an agent task. Durability and taste need data almost no benchmark publishes.

entry.title: Terminal-Bench Task: Lakehouse Schema Contract Drift
entry.summary: A Terminal-Bench task where the schema contract drifts between epochs, built as a counterexample for coding agents.

entry.title: 5.3-Flash Has Large Provider Cache Hit Variance
entry.summary: GLM-5.3-Flash cache hit rates on OpenRouter ranged from 80% on Z.AI to 0% on DeepInfra and Fireworks. Quality clustered. Cost did not follow cache, because output tokens dominate this workload.

entry.title: 3 Lessons from Building a 170GB Iceberg Lakehouse with 8GB RAM
entry.summary: Building a 170GB Apache Iceberg lakehouse on 8GB RAM: lane registry and schema contracts for 9 pipelines, incremental gold with snapshot-consistent DuckDB serving, and memory-bounded promotion.

entry.title: On-chain Atomic Gaussian Math
entry.summary: On-chain Gaussian math on Sui using the AAA algorithm for rational approximation of the normal CDF and inverse CDF, evaluated via Horner's method with fixed-point arithmetic.

entry.title: Building an Agentic Native MCP for Data Science
entry.summary: Building igloo-mcp, an MCP server for Snowflake data science with safe query execution, schema-first tools, catalog building, and dependency graph analysis.

entry.title: Sui NFT Analytics
entry.summary: Sui NFT analytics pipeline built with Sentio processors and SQL Studio to track Rootlets NFT holder counts, ownership history, and thematic categorization.

entry.title: Data Observability with Sentio Pipelines
entry.summary: Sentio pipelines enable end-to-end web3 data observability with typed TypeScript processors, real-time streaming, and SQL/GraphQL endpoints, demoed via a Sui LST dashboard.

entry.title: Economics of Sui Shared Liquidity Pool Objects
entry.summary: Sui shared liquidity pool mutations saturate nearly every checkpoint, yet max gas fees don't guarantee top block position, informing SIP-45 prioritized transaction submission.

entry.title: Economic Implications of a Competitive Blob Market
entry.summary: The competitive Ethereum blob market pressures L2 profit margins (up to 99%) and projects fee revenue growth from $11M to $25M with expanded blob counts and higher priority fees.

entry.title: Tackling Blob Fee Slippage with Preconfirmations
entry.summary: Blob fee slippage during June 2024 Ethereum congestion cost rollups millions; preconfirmations on mev-commit cut inclusion times 1000x to ~75ms bid latency.

entry.title: Clustering Analysis on Zeta <> Pyth Transaction Logs
entry.summary: Agglomerative clustering analysis on Zeta and Pyth Solana transaction logs using Polars DataFrames to identify failure rate patterns and log message groupings.

entry.title: Conquering Solana Data Analytics Part 1 - Tooling
entry.summary: Solana data analytics tooling comparison: benchmarking Cryptohouse, Dune, and Flipside on three SQL queries against the transactions table for performance and features.

entry.title: Economic Costs of Failed Transactions on Solana
entry.summary: Solana's Pyth receiver contract has a 26.5% transaction failure rate, 3.3x the network average, costing publishers ~10 SOL monthly with no validator incentive to reduce failures.

entry.title: Calculate Jito Tips in Solana
entry.summary: Solana ETL pipeline in Python to calculate and analyze Jito tips, comparing transaction fees against compute costs across a single block using Solana-py.

entry.title: Slot Inclusion Rates and Blob Market Combinatorics
entry.summary: Blob market combinatorics: an integer packing problem in Ethereum where small block capacity drives higher slot inclusion rates via rollup competition rather than builder censorship.

entry.title: Streaming Embedded OLAP Data Pipeline with LanceDB + DuckDB in Python
entry.summary: Embedded OLAP streaming data pipeline using LanceDB, DuckDB, and Hypersync to query and analyze blockchain data with mutable columnar storage in Python.

entry.title: Analyzing Blob Inclusion Rates and Market Strategies
entry.summary: EIP-4844 blob market analysis measuring slot inclusion rates, Optimism and Base blob posting strategies, and priority fee correlation with inclusion speed.
